description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ImportViewUndo' which handles the undo step of an import process in the SuiteCRM system. It manages the user interface for undoing the last import, including rendering templates and executing the undo operation via the 'undo' method on an 'Import_2' bean.

classes.name: ImportViewUndo
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the undo last import page and executing the undo action.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the undo last import view, sets up template variables, and calls the undo operation.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for handling the form submission related to the undo operation.
